Title: 2016-06-06 PTR Patch
Subtitle: === Heroes: Abathur ===
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Abathur ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • You can no longer use Hearthstone to port back to base while channeling Ultimate Evolution.
  • Fixed an issue that allowed Evolve Monstosity to pick up coins and gems, which were then permanently lost upon death.

=== Heroes: Brightwing ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • The additional pulses created from the Continuous Winds talents will now properly push back enemy Heroes.
  • Fixed an issue that allowed Brightwing to heal allies with Soothing Mist while dead.

=== Heroes: Chen ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • The leap distances of the Storm Earth, Fire clones should now be consistent.

=== Heroes: Cho ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Shadow Bolt Volley can no longer be canceled by right clicking.

=== Heroes: Dehaka ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Shift queuing a command to use Essence Collection will now correctly heal Dehaka.

=== Heroes: Gall ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Shadow Bolt Volley can no longer be canceled by right clicking.

=== Heroes: Medivh ===
[Releases]
  Medivh, The Last Guardian, has been added to the Nexus and is now available for play! Read on for a brief overview of his Abilities.:
  Trait:
  • Raven Form (Z)
    • Instead of Mounting, Medivh can transform into a raven, increasing Movement Speed by 15%. While transformed, you can see and fly over all terrain, and are immune to all effects. Casting an Ability immediately transforms you out of Raven Form.
  Basic Abilities:
  • Arcane Rift (Q)
    • Launch a rift that damages all enemies in its path. If an enemy Hero is hit, Arcane Rift's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and 30 Mana is refunded.
  • Force of Will (W)
    • Protect an allied Hero from all damage for 1.5 seconds.
  • Portal (E)
    • Create a set of portals between you and the target location, allowing allies to teleport between them. Portals last 6 seconds.
  Heroic Abilities:
  • Poly Bomb (R)
    • Polymorph an enemy Hero, suppressing their attacks and Silencing them for 2 seconds. On expiration, Poly Bomb spreads to other nearby enemy Heroes.
  • Ley Line Seal (R)
    • After 0.5 seconds, unleash a wave of energy that imprisons enemy Heroes in Stasis for 3 seconds.

=== Heroes: Sylvanas ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that made Xul uncontrollable if Sylvanas and Xul cast Mind Control and Bone Prison on each other

=== Heroes: The Butcher ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • The cooldown of the Enraged talent now accurately matches the tooltip at 25 seconds.
  • Hamstring now deals the correct amount of damage to Heroic targets when both the Cheap Shot and Chop Meat talents are selected.

=== Heroes: Tracer ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Basic Attack sounds will no longer play during Polymorph effects.
  • The Pulse Rounds talent should now increase the range and charge rate of Pulse Bomb by the amount stated in the tooltip.

=== Heroes: Tyrael ===
[Updates]
  Basic Abilities:
  El'Druin's Might (Q):
  • Mana cost reduced from 55 to 50
  Righteousness (W):
  • Mana cost reduced from 65 to 60
  Smite (E):
  • Mana cost reduced from 50 to 45
  Judgment (R):
  • Mana cost reduced from 100 to 80
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed a bug that caused Archangel's Wrath to explode immediately in specific situations.

=== Heroes: Xul ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that made Xul uncontrollable if Sylvanas and Xul cast Mind Control and Bone Prison on each other
